🌊🎣  Welcome to Fish An Egg from Rivers!

How to Play:
🥚 Fish eggs from Rivers
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare pets
💰 Earn money from your pets
⬆️ Upgrade your rods and base
🪺 Steal eggs from other players
✨ Discover rarer eggs, pets, sizes, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
